name: avaagent
description: Local Avalanche wallet and swap control for Codex through the AvaAgent CLI and schemas.

interface.shortDescription: Control a local Avalanche wallet and real swaps from Codex.
interface.longDescription: A local-first Codex plugin wrapper for AvaAgent. It exposes wallet creation, balances, transfers, AI command parsing, and 0x-backed Avalanche swap execution through a deterministic CLI and JSON schemas.
defaultPrompt: Create a local Avalanche wallet with AvaAgent.
Quote swapping 0.1 AVAX into USDC on Avalanche.
Use AvaAgent to send 1 USDC to a wallet.
